stem: One attempt to resolve this issue without violence involved which action?

options.label: F
options.text: The Cherokee Nation challenged Georgia's anti-Cherokee laws before the U.S. Supreme Court.

options.label: G
options.text: Georgia asked the federal government for funds to purchase Cherokee land.

options.label: H
options.text: The Cherokee Nation asked President Andrew Jackson to negotiate with Georgia.

options.label: J
options.text: Georgia offered to grant U.S. citizenship to the Cherokees.

visual_elements: Gold was discovered on Cherokee land.
Georgia annexed Cherokee land and abolished the Cherokee government and its laws.
The Cherokees refused to move from their land.
